title: Water utilities in Spain

input.solutionDescription: AI leak-detection and water-network monitoring software
input.businessObjective: Shortlist Spanish utilities worth researching for outbound marketing

marketSignals: Should surface water-loss / non-revenue-water as a real problem area
Should look for EU or national regulation and any funding for network efficiency
Signals must each carry a source and a date where a date is expected
candidates: Real, identifiable Spanish water operators (regional or municipal)
organisationType should be from the allowed enum (water-utility, municipality, etc.)
Each candidate must carry relevance evidence, not just a name
mustAvoid: Inventing utilities that cannot be sourced
Confusing bottled-water brands with network/utility operators
Any outreach or contact instruction in recommendations
expectedCharacteristics.sourceExpectations: Prefer Tier A/B (regulators, official portals, trade press) over promotional vendor pages

notes: Strongest, most concrete case — a well-defined market with public regulators and operators.
